_comment: Provenance for every third-party byte served by this app. Nothing here is
fetched at runtime: the files sit in this directory and are served from it,
which is what makes the app work with the network switched off.
tests/test_web_assets.py re-hashes each file against the sha256 below, so a
vendored asset cannot be swapped, patched or upgraded without the change
showing up as a failing test and a diff in this file.
To upgrade: fetch the new version from BOTH urls, check the two agree
byte-for-byte, write the file, and update version + sha256 here.
